title: Measuring the local shape of learning-rate transfer curves
abstract: arXiv:2610.21814v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding the learning-rate (LR) dependence of trained model performance is essential for better optimization of neural networks, but the appropriate size of the LR depends on learning dynamics, architecture, and their hidden biases, and thus our understanding of this complex dependence remains limited. The behavior of the loss curve as a function of the LR has recently been observed in extensive experiments on LR transfer across different settings, such as model sizes, and it is becoming more important to explore methodologies for quantitatively characterizing the shape of this LR curve. In this work, we provide two relational equations that give a good empirical explanation of the gradient of the LR transfer curve, i.e., the LR gradient. translated_title: 测量学习率迁移曲线的局部形状
translated_abstract: 理解训练后模型性能对学习率（LR）的依赖关系对于更好地优化神经网络至关重要，但合适的学习率大小取决于学习动力学、架构及其隐含的偏置，因此我们对这种复杂依赖关系的理解仍然有限。近年来，通过在不同设置（如不同模型规模）之间进行学习率迁移的大量实验，人们观察到了损失曲线作为学习率函数的行为，探索定量刻画这种学习率曲线形状的方法正变得愈发重要。在这项工作中，我们提供了两个关系方程，能够对学习率迁移曲线的梯度（即学习率梯度）给出良好的经验解释。其中一个是基于稳定性边缘成立的理论公式，另一个是通过将该梯度简单地视为超参数梯度而得到的近似表达式。利用这两个公式，本文为定量理解与预测学习率曲线的局部形状提供了方法论基础。
tldr: 本文提出两个关系方程——一个在稳定性边缘成立的理论公式和一个将学习率梯度视为超参数梯度的近似表达式——从经验上很好地解释了学习率迁移曲线的梯度，为定量刻画学习率曲线的局部形状提供了方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two relational equations—a theoretical formula valid at the edge of stability and an approximate expression treating the LR gradient as a hyper-parameter gradient—that empirically explain the gradient of learning-rate transfer curves, enabling quantitative characterization of their local shape.
